chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala' ibn Fadl, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Three [characteristics], if they are in a man, do not hesitate to say that he is in Hell: harshness (lack of softness/gentleness), cowardice, and miserliness. And three [characteristics], if they are in a woman, do not hesitate to say that she is in Hell: scurrility (coarseness of speech/behavior), haughtiness, and corruption (immorality).

key_terms.بَذَاءٌ: Scurrility or coarseness in speech and behavior
key_terms.جَفَاءٌ: Harshness or lack of gentleness/softness in character

ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics in men and women that indicate they will go to Hell according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith presents a concise typology of spiritual ruin, linking specific vices to their ultimate eschatological consequence. The Imam’s assertion that these traits are sufficient indicators of Hellfire underscores the Shia emphasis on character (*akhlaq*) as a primary determinant of faith, reflecting the broader scholarly tradition that moral decay inevitably leads to divine punishment.
